summary: Enlivex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its board's decision to effect a 1-for-15 reverse share split, approved by shareholders on February 3, 2026. The split reduces authorized shares from 2.375 billion to ~158.3 million and outstanding shares from ~252.5 million to ~16.8 million. No fractional shares will be issued; rounding up applies. Trading on Nasdaq on a split-adjusted basis begins July 9, 2026. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event is involved.
